title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (continued from the previous page). G = GL(2) over a base ring or scheme, and PG = PGL(2). We have sections ρ̃, σ̃ of PG and a strict additive one-parameter subgroup ε̃_0 : G_a → PG with σ̃^{-1}ρ̃ = ε̃_0(1). Then ε̃_1 := σ̃ ε̃_0 σ̃^{-1} = ρ̃ ε̃_0 ρ̃^{-1}, and ε̃_1(1) = ρ̃σ̃^{-1}. The earlier parts of the proposition say:
- ε̃_i lifts uniquely to unipotent subgroups ε_i(t) = 1 + tN_i of G, with N_i nilpotent.
- For any lifts ρ, σ one has ε_0 = -λ_0 σ^{-1}ρ for a unique unit λ_0.

What this page states.
- Part 3, end. Choosing ρ suitably once σ is fixed gives λ_0 = 1. That is (56): ε_0 = -σ^{-1}ρ, hence ε_1 = -ρσ^{-1}.
- Part 4. With (56) imposed, ε_0 and ε_1 are 'independent' fibrewise (N_0 and N_1 not homothetic on any fibre) if and only if Tr(ρ+σ) is a unit. Equivalent conditions are referred to a proposition on p. 478'.
- Part 5. Imposing in addition the normalisation Tr(ρ+σ) = Trρ + Trσ = 1 fixes the remaining common scalar. So ρ and σ are determined uniquely by (ρ̃, σ̃, ε̃_0). Elsewhere this normalisation is called u = 1, equivalently ρ+σ is an elementary (rank-one) projector.

Modern check of Part 4.
- From (56), ρ = -σε_0, so ρ+σ = σ(1-ε_0) = -σN_0.
- Write N_0 = v⊗φ with φ(v) = 0. Then N_1 = σN_0σ^{-1} has image line σv.
- Tr(ρ+σ) = -φ(σv). This is invertible iff σv ∉ ker φ = ⟨v⟩ on every fibre, i.e. iff N_0 and N_1 have distinct image lines (are not homothetic).
- Rescaling (ρ,σ) ↦ (λρ,λσ) preserves (56) and multiplies the trace by λ. Hence the normalisation Tr = 1 exists and is unique.
- If ρ+σ = P is a rank-one projector, then N_0 = -σ^{-1}P is rank one, and it is nilpotent iff its trace is 0.

Modular example.
- Take σ = S = [[0,-1],[1,0]] (order 4) and ε_0 = [[1,-1],[0,1]].
- Then ρ = -σε_0 = [[0,1],[-1,1]], of order 6 with trace 1. So Tr(ρ+σ) = 1 and det ρ = det σ = 1.
- This is the standard pair of generators of SL_2(Z) (images of orders 2 and 3 in PSL_2(Z)), with ε_0 and ε_1 the two parabolic generators.
- So the proposition describes, over an arbitrary base, the 'modular-type' configurations in PGL_2: lifts of an order-2/order-3-type pair whose quotients are transverse unipotents. This is relevant to the loop equation / genus-0 Teichmüller and modular-group material of the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets'.

Remark 1. The conditions of p. 478' other than the normalisation are symmetric under ρ ↔ σ. Setting ρ' = σ, σ' = ρ gives ε'_0 = -ρ^{-1}σ = ε_0^{-1} and ε'_1 = ε_1^{-1}, which checks out. The page then begins the analogous statement for (ρ^{-1}, σ^{-1}). The next page shows that the trace normalisation is preserved there only when det ρ = det σ = 1.
errors: Numbering slips: '4)' is used twice (the first is really the end of item 3, giving λ_0 = 1). The label (57) is used both for 'Tr(ρ+σ) invertible' and for 'Tr(ρ+σ) = 1'.
Last line: '(ρ', σ'^{-1})' is presumably a slip for (ρ^{-1}, σ^{-1}), as the next page's (60) shows.
Mathematically, the statements check out (verified via ρ+σ = -σN_0 and Tr = -φ(σv)).

ideas.what: Normalising lifts ρ, σ ∈ GL2 of sections of PGL2 so that -σ^{-1}ρ and -ρσ^{-1} are the two transverse unipotents, with Tr(ρ+σ) = 1 (ρ+σ a rank-one projector) fixing the scalar ambiguity uniquely.
ideas.modern_name: Rigidification / normal form of PGL2-valued representations of PSL2(Z) (or of π1 of P^1 minus 3 points) with parabolic monodromy; lifting from PGL2 to GL2
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (normal forms of SL2(Z) generators); general-base version folklore

ideas.what: Criterion: N_0 and N_1 are fibrewise non-homothetic iff Tr(ρ+σ) is invertible.
ideas.modern_name: Transversality of parabolic fixed points (irreducibility criterion for 2-dim parabolic representations)

ideas.what: Symmetries of the normalised data under ρ↔σ (ε_i ↦ ε_i^{-1}) and under inversion, setting up a choice among four natural pinnings (épinglages).
ideas.modern_name: Automorphisms of the presentation of PSL2(Z) acting on pinnings of PGL2

deep.surprise_reason: Careful but routine linear-algebra normalisation of GL2 lifts of a modular-type pair in PGL2 over a general base. It is correct, and nothing here appears new to specialists.
transcription_corrections: Top-of-page number '483' is Grothendieck's own pagination; the archive page is 363.
Second '(57)' and the first '4)' are Grothendieck's own duplicate labels, not transcription errors.
Margin note near (57) bis reads roughly 'par une proportionnalité indéterminée' (uncertain), not just 'par une proportionnalité [?]'.
'{+Choix forts+}' is a parenthetical insertion over 'ρ, σ' and may read '(choix forts)'.
Last line: 'satisfait aux cns conditions' — 'cns' is struck through or abbreviated; read 'satisfait aux conditions de la p. 478', et permet'.
